evidence: Source review of goal holders on staging b98eb7175 keeps native build 1 compatible, with one retired path. Compared against the Swift sources: the Chief, Manager and Ticket conversation routes, ticket, review, recap, settled, deployment-status and resource-version contracts are unchanged. GET /api/managers/{id}/workspace only adds fields (ManagerDetail ignores extras). Goals no longer have conversations, so the server removes /api/goals/{id}/conversation/start-values, /send and /reset. Build 1 reaches these only through a goal-owned Review item or goal artifact (ConversationOwner.goal). There, starting or sending gets an HTTP 404 error instead of an action, so nothing runs. GET /api/goals/{id} no longer returns conversation_id; the app's optional conversationId decodes as nil, and old goal transcripts stay readable by id through /api/conversation/conversations/{id}. Not checked on a signed device: goal-owned Review rows and TestFlight behavior.
